architectural_units.name: Client
architectural_units.description: The client is the user of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Server
architectural_units.description: The server is the software that is responsible for processing user requests.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for displaying information to the user.

architectural_units.name: Business Layer
architectural_units.description: This layer is the core of the application and is responsible for processing all the information.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for storing all the data.

architectural_units.name: API Gateway
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for the management, authentication and authorization of platform users.

architectural_units.name: Core
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for performing the business logic of the platform, it would be the main core of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Analytical Module
architectural_units.description: This service has the main function of obtaining and processing playlog, connection and platform action data.

architectural_units.name: Api Player
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for communicating with the players by receiving all the information corresponding to it.

architectural_units.name: Web Socket
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for carrying out the communication between the platform and the players.

architectural_units.name: Database
architectural_units.description: The database used is a MySQL database that is responsible for storing all the data necessary for the operation of the system.

architectural_units.name: MySQL
architectural_units.description: The database used is a MySQL database.

architectural_units.name: RDS
architectural_units.description: This database is implemented in the RDS service, which is a distributed relational database service from AWS.

architectural_units.name: Data Lake
architectural_units.description: The objective of these services is to form a data lake where all the history is stored to be able to process them in the analytical module.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: This is the AWS object storage service.

architectural_units.name: DynamoDB
architectural_units.description: This service is a non-relational database from AWS.

architectural_units.name: NestJS
architectural_units.description: Framework used to develop the different services that interact with each other.

architectural_units.name: TypeScript
architectural_units.description: Programming language used for NestJS.

architectural_units.name: AWS
architectural_units.description: Cloud services used for infrastructure.

architectural_units.name: Amazon Athena
architectural_units.description: Service that allows SQL queries to be performed on data stored in Amazon S3.

architectural_units.name: AWS Glue
architectural_units.description: Serverless data integration service that allows for the detection, preparation, migration, and integration of data.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Streams
architectural_units.description: Data processing and ingestion service aimed especially at data streaming.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
architectural_units.description: Service whose main function is the loading of large amounts of data into data warehouses.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: Communication protocol between the presentation layer and the API Gateway.

architectural_units.name: TCP
architectural_units.description: Communication protocol between microservices.

architectural_units.name: Player
architectural_units.description: A device that can be internal or external, which allows screens to play content.
The presentation layer communicates with the capa de negoci, more specifically with the Api Gateway, using the HTTP protocol.
The communication between the Api Gateway service and the other services (Core, Analytical Module) is via the TCP communication protocol.
A web socket is the technology that allows bidirectional communication between the platform and the players.
The Core service interacts with the database.
The Analytical Module interacts with the database.
The Web Socket service processes data from players and stores it in the database and cloud services.
The Analytical Module interacts with cloud services (Data Lake).
The Core service interacts with cloud services.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The Waapiti platform is a web service that follows the client-server architecture.

patterns.name: Three Layers
patterns.description: The client-server model uses a 3-layer architecture, where the system is divided into 3 layers.

patterns.name: API Gateway
patterns.description: This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform.
